skill_isolation.limitation_note: Skills are staged into the self-contained plugin tree; skill-level isolation relies on repository and workspace boundaries since Codex loads plugin skills into the active session context.

forks.omission_note: Session forks are not supported or exposed in headless execution; parallel exploration must be orchestrated externally via isolated workspaces.

subagents.note: Custom subagents are defined as skill wrappers with OpenAI agent manifests under skills/agent-<name>/ and dispatched via Codex spawn_agent.

worktrees.limitation_note: Git worktree switching within a single session is not supported natively; Workcell uses external jj workspaces to isolate parallel work.

workflow_surfaces.omission_note: Interactive Workflow UI surfaces are omitted in headless mode; execution adheres strictly to CLI command line, prompt input, and JSON handoff schemas.

command_hooks.note: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and Stop command hooks are supported natively via hooks/hooks.json and invoke shared guards.

mode.limitation_note: Codex does not expose a per-agent mode surface or API-level reasoning.mode: 'pro'; mode remains unconfigurable via prompt or frontmatter.

programmatic_tool_calling.limitation_note: Programmatic Tool Calling, allowed_callers, and program_output are API-only features that Codex cannot express through agent instructions; tool routing relies on harness-provided tools.

responses_api_multi_agent.limitation_note: The Responses API multi-agent beta is API-only and not enabled by a Codex prompt; Codex multi-agent execution uses harness-provided agent controls.
